provenance.note: a kick that is the rhythm and not the sub, for the deep half-time place where the bass line carries the low end: the short kick's drop onto 60 Hz, the body open to 220 Hz so its punch sits over the bass's fundamental, -10 dB at 35 ms and -34 dB by 120 (the room's kick it replaces is 54 -> 46 Hz under a 130 Hz lid, -34 dB only after 270 ms), and a click at 3.2 kHz near the body's level so the hit reads on a phone speaker (through the phone model the kick reads 2-5 dB over the room's); its trim between the short kick's and the punch's, the drum in front of the line and not under it

notes.loudnessDb: MEASURED in round DUB-1 by the drum gate (`tools/test-drums.ts --only kickKnock`, no bless): -16.65 at 44.1 and 48 kHz in Chromium and Firefox at trim 0.75 (a trim of 1 took its peak 3 dB over the room's kick and the limiter with it)
